processing: All six source PNG files copied unchanged from builtin image_gen output. Only each pose-owned, fixed-size brow patch is composited on the approved pose. Eyebrow motion is present in the authored source painting; registration does not scale, rotate, mirror, warp, interpolate or move a source patch with the coefficient. Existing mouth, gaze and eye assets/registration are inherited unchanged. Two fixed soft exclusion masks preserve the lower fine-hair junctions in the right pose; masks sit below the union of all neutral/new brow strokes and use the approved underlying composite. They do not move or repaint the source artwork.
limitations: Two fixed side poses only. Every new brow state has one painting per pose; no graded strength or in-between drawings.
The two eyebrows are independently cropped from each pose-specific bilateral painting, enabling asymmetric combinations without mirroring.
Each eyebrow selects one state with priority down > innerUp > outerUp. Simultaneous inner and outer raising does not create a combined painting.
The approved style includes faint brow visibility through some thin bangs. Foreground hair is not an independently animated layer.
Full source portraits are generated; only registered local brow patches are used by the renderer.

At 4.5x nearest-neighbor inspection, the far outerUp fine-hair upper segment retains a slight line-width/color difference. The fixed exclusions restore the lower junction cores, not the entire original hair strand.
